about: The portal console's auth-gate environment, supplied from Secret Manager only (GR-6). This file names the secret IDS the runtime reads and how each reaches the container; it never carries a value. It is the single source of truth for the two env names, the mount path and the secret ids: infra/terraform/modules/web-surface projects it into the Cloud Run service, infra/portal/mirror-auth-gate-jwks.sh names the secret it publishes into, and scripts/check-portal-auth-env.sh refuses a declaration that drifts from the code the console actually reads (portal/server/sso.py) or a value carried in either half.

secrets.source: a mirror of the OS auth gate's published GET /auth/.well-known/jwks.json, published by infra/portal/mirror-auth-gate-jwks.sh
secrets.why: portal/server/sso.py OPENS this path, so the payload must arrive as a mounted file: a secret injected as the value of a *_FILE variable would be read as a pathname, and the console exits 1 at boot (docs/AGENTCONSOLE-HOSTING.md rows 2-3).

secrets.source: the comma-separated super-admin allowlist (one line, no trailing newline)
secrets.why: the local allowlist decides super_admin, never the token's role claim, and it has no baked-in default — an unset allowlist means no super-admin at all.

not_supplied.reason: the inline-payload alternative, deliberately NOT part of the deploy route: supplying it from Secret Manager would put the whole mirror (a credential-bearing trust set) in the revision's environment, where it is readable from the container spec, instead of in a read-only mounted file. An operator reaching for it on the compose route (contrib/shared-services/agentconsole.compose.yml) still can; the deployed surface uses the file.
